entries.title: Bring keys you keep in another tool into Secrets, without your crew seeing them
entries.body: Your crew can now offer to bring keys from another tool, such as a .env file or a password tool's command, into Secrets. Infinitary shows its own card naming the exact command or file and a tick box for each key. When you press Bring into Secrets, Infinitary runs or reads it itself and keeps only what you ticked; your crew gets names and references, never a value. A key you already keep arrives unticked, so nothing is replaced unless you choose it.

picture.alt: Infinitary's card asking to bring two secrets from Automic Vault, with the exact command and folder it runs, the crewmate's reason, and two secrets to tick: one ticked, and one already in Secrets left unticked until you choose to replace it, above Don't bring and Bring into Secrets
